verdict.rationale: On the Claude API, a skill reference takes an optional `version` alongside `skill_id`, and a Skill Versions API handles version management, so API callers can pin a specific skill version. In Claude Code, plugins carry a version in `plugin.json` and support versioned releases. However, marketplaces advertise automatic updates, with no documented way to pin a plugin version or turn those updates off. Missing for 10: a lockfile or documented version pinning for Claude Code plugins and marketplaces, a documented opt-out from automatic updates, team-wide update controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
